name: GitHub MCP Server 2.3.0
body:
## Highlights
- Security product update tools
- Swift added global security advisories
- Lots of dependency upgrades

## What's Changed
* Remove thread_resolution_reason feature flag by @cagesellchen in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3727
* Add experimental pull request artifact tools by @talum in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3843
* Add Dependabot alert update tool by @belaltaher8 in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3887
* Add code scanning alert update tool by @belaltaher8 in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3888
* Add secret scanning alert update tool by @belaltaher8 in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3889
* [Copilot Dreaming] Avoid invalid tool workflows and remove stale or duplicate guidance by @Copilot in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3894
* docs(antigravity): fix MCP config path and remote server key by @zhiganovsasha in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3840
* ci: update and group CodeQL actions together by @SamMorrowDrums in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3900
* build(deps): bump go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 from 3.0.5 to 3.0.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3898
* build(deps): bump golang from 1.27.3-alpine to 1.27.4-alpine by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3897
* build(deps): bump github.com/spf13/pflag from 1.0.10 to 1.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3830
* Keep automation confirmation on delete only and tighten tool schemas by @A-Georgiou in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3867
* build: align go.mod and docs with Go 1.27.4 by @SamMorrowDrums in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3904
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3902
* build(deps): bump the codeql group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3901
* build(deps): bump goreleaser/goreleaser-action from 7.2.3 to 7.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3903
* fix: complete pull request content paths from the PR head by @chanyang721 in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3860
* build(deps): bump golang.org/x/oauth2 from 0.37.0 to 0.38.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3829
* docs: correct fine-grained PAT organization controls in policies-and-governance.md by @Johnbjoseph-cybersec in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3825
* build(deps): bump react-dom from 19.3.0 to 19.3.1 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3618
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 from 5.4.0 to 5.5.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3616
* build(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.3.2 to 8.3.5 in /ui in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3544
* build(deps): bump zod from 4.6.5 to 4.6.6 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3512
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3511
* Add Gemini plugin manifest with initial version by @IrynaKulakova in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3910
* fix: accept the swift ecosystem in list_global_security_advisories by @burrows99 in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3937

## New Contributors
* @talum made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3843
* @belaltaher8 made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3887
* @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3894
* @zhiganovsasha made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3840
* @chanyang721 made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3860
* @Johnbjoseph-cybersec made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3825
* @burrows99 made their first contribution in https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/pull/3937

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/compare/v2.2.0...v2.3.0
